round: noise-halving follow-up (round 2 of the box lane stock)
question: After the fix for the box half-count reads (quarter-turn orientations of the registered box no longer candidates; the lane's own product wins among height matches; other candidates judged in metres against the noise), does the box lane stock stay free of wrong counts under 0.5/1/2 % range noise, with enough lanes that no bound is inconclusive?
decision_unit: one lane survey frame, scored on the lane it was taken for (stock_scorer, as CMB-114)
splits: ros_ws/src/restocker_benchmarks/config/perception_splits_v4.json (schema 4, append-only over v3; adds seeds 285..364 all held-out, burns the 13 v3 seeds of the first lane-stock run)

held_out_population.rule: v4 fresh held-out seeds 309..364, none recorded or read before this file is committed
held_out_population.expected_lanes: 56 seeds x 6 = 336 lanes; box lanes expected about 190 (v3 held-out had 3.4 box lanes per seed); box bounds need >= 150 (120 for the noise box-wrong bound, because refusals shrink the answered set)
held_out_population.development_data: v4 seeds 285..308 (24 seeds, 144 lanes, recorded with the pre-fix and post-fix code). They are held-out-designated seeds (they carry the held-out slim box GEN-020, which the train and validation seeds never draw) used as development here; they are consumed and are not used in this round's held-out run. Seeds 242, 243, 246, 247, 257, 258, 260, 266, 267, 279, 280, 282, 283 and 2101..2136 were the first run's held-out and are burned.
held_out_population.dev_result_that_set_the_values: post-fix code on the 24 development seeds, 4 noise realisations per frame: answered-wrong 0 of 414 / 418 / 380 at 1 / 0.5 / 2 % (pre-fix code: 5 and 11 wrong at 1 and 0.5 %, all slim box lanes); answered 97.6 % / 98.6 % / 89.6 %; box lanes exact among answered 100 % at 0.5 and 1 %.

noise_model: as lane_stock_acceptance_bounds_r2.json (Gaussian range noise 0.5/1/2 %, 2 % dropout, synthetic; realisation seeded by the frame id)

arms.abstain+degrade: half the frames lose a band of 30-70 % of rows
arms.not_run: oracle and channel arms: identity is untouched

bounds.meaning: box lanes with sufficient coverage whose count is exactly right; a refusal is a miss
box lanes answered more than one product off, or a phantom
nothing wrong is answered under blinding
lanes still answered at 0.5 % and 1 % noise
false-count rate under noise, every lane (round 1 of box perception failed this at 1 %: 8 of 78 against 0.10)
false-count rate under noise, box lanes (the failed bound, tightened from 0.20)
box lanes answered at 0.5 % and 1 % are mostly exactly right, not just within one
empty lanes stay empty under noise

pass_rule: as lane_stock_acceptance_bounds_r2.json: a 'min' bound passes only if the lower 95 % Wilson limit is at or above the value, a 'max' bound only if the upper limit is at or below it, and the sample size is met; a bound with a 'group' is evaluated on that condition's block (a report with no such lane is inconclusive). Sample sizes were planned up front from the expected lane counts above; a bound that comes out inconclusive for n is reported as such and is not a pass. A fail is recorded as a fail; nothing is re-run and no estimator or configuration change follows this file.
frozen: estimator and lane_stock.yaml as committed with this file; the proposer is not part of this round
